Fresh install · no seeded history or goals

Current flow. Phone Sense explains usage access, sends the user to Android’s usage-access controls, explains its notifications, and then offers Turn on notifications or Not now. Enabling notifications invokes Android’s permission dialog on Android 13 and newer. Either choice then opens Home using the internal Saturday week start and 07:00 notification time. There are no day or time controls in onboarding.

Owner review notes

  • Full justification produces visibly wider word spacing on some short lines, especially in the first paragraph. This is the requested alignment and should be checked on narrow or large-font devices.
  • Android’s usage-access explanation mentions carrier, language, and other details beyond the app’s narrower explanation.
  • The notification permission dialog appears over Home because onboarding completes when the system request is launched.
  • A fresh Home can contain a small non-zero total because time spent in Android settings is real foreground usage.
  • The original ticket requested schedule defaults and pickers. Those captures are intentionally absent because the later product direction removed user-selectable week-start and notification-time controls from onboarding.

Older Android behavior

Android 12L and older do not show the runtime notification-permission dialog. Choosing Turn on notifications creates the same four channels and proceeds to Home. Usage-access labels, layout, and wording can also vary by Android release and device maker. Choosing Not now records the skipped choice and proceeds to Home on every supported version.
